# UpDownBalance {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
UpDownBalance()
```
Chart choice for the β-chart (up-down balance) by Bandt (2019), Equation (3). For pattern length `m = 3`, the statistic is $\hat{\beta} = \hat{p}_1 - \hat{p}_6$, based on the relative frequencies of the decreasing and increasing patterns.
 


:::
